description: This file defines the TrackerListController class, which extends an abstract Vue controller. It is part of the OrangeHRM Performance plugin, responsible for managing the performance tracker list view by setting up a Vue component during the preRender phase.

classes.name: TrackerListController
classes.description: Controller class for managing the performance tracker list view, extending the AbstractVueController.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Sets up the Vue component 'performance-tracker-list' before rendering the view.
